verdict.rationale: Pylon's developer docs describe first-party webhooks as user-defined HTTP callbacks triggered by specific events in Pylon. The bring-your-own-agent docs also name webhooks as a way to connect agents to ticketing workflows, so programmatic event subscription is documented. Missing for 10: the list of subscribable event types, payload schema, signing/verification and retry details, how webhooks are registered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks are user-defined HTTP callbacks that are triggered by specific events within Pylon.
Receive webhooks for various events happening in Pylon.
Using a combination of Webhooks, API, and/or Pylon MCP, you can connect your agent to ticketing workflows in Pylon.
